component.name: Waypane
component.summary: A native workspace for shells and remote systems

description.p: Waypane brings terminal sessions, SSH connections, SFTP navigation, and tunnels together in a local-first Linux workspace.
Restores the Ctrl+Insert copy and Shift+Insert paste shortcuts in embedded terminals.
Adds selection of existing Waypane connections as profile-aware SSH jump hosts, including ordered multi-hop chains.
Adds copy-ready MCP setup helpers for Codex and Claude, project configuration guidance, and the current version in Settings.
Keeps failed SSH diagnostics visible and suggests legacy compatibility when negotiation fails.
Fixes Flatpak local terminal startup and exports the application icon to desktop launchers.
Initial development release of the Waypane remote workspace.
